hotspots.title: Trump’s election fraud claims dominate coverage

hotspots.title: Vox’s legal and political battles in Spain
hotspots.blurb: Spain’s far-right Vox party continues to clash with the government and other political factions over issues such as immigration, amnesty laws, and regional policies. The party’s aggressive stance and legal challenges have fueled intense media coverage.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to Vox’s confrontational tactics, legal battles, and the moral panic surrounding its policies, which have polarized Spanish politics.
